Description: Free messages for evaluating Lambek as a conversational system, sent as the app sends them. Each case is a conversation of its own. Expect.Reply is answer (Contains: every item must appear, alternatives split by |; Avoid: none may appear), abstain (Lambek must say it does not understand or does not know, or say one of Accept), or action (a ready plan with that action). The test split is frozen: TestHash is the hash of its cases, never edit them while working on Lambek. The fresh split holds messages written for one step and never looked at while working on it: measured once at the end of the step, they then join the calibration split, and new fresh messages are written for the next step.

Contains: de rien|avec plaisir|je vous en prie|plaisir
